confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are firmer than accommodation, which varies with July demand. Cocktail and wine are less certain and were sanity-checked against the beer price. EUR is converted at an assumed rate of about 1.16 USD per EUR, not verified. The FX figure comes from RBA search results; the RBA page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to large German city price levels such as Hamburg and Cologne, adjusted for Berlin's moderate restaurant prices and July accommodation demand. No comparable-city data was searched.

anchor_basis.beer: 0.5 L draft Pilsner at a neighborhood bar or restaurant, about EUR 5.00
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a neighborhood cafe, about EUR 3.90
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: one main course at a casual Turkish or Vietnamese restaurant, no drink, about EUR 13
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: two three-course dinners at a mid-range restaurant, no drinks, about EUR 85 total
anchor_basis.cocktail: classic cocktail such as a Negroni at a bar, about EUR 12
anchor_basis.wine_glass: 0.2 L glass of house wine at a restaurant, about EUR 6.50
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a 4 to 8 bed mixed dorm at a central registered hostel in July, about EUR 38 per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a central registered hostel in July, about EUR 90 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room at a registered Pension or 1-star hotel in July, about EUR 100 per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered 3-star hotel in July, about EUR 165 per night
